answer: The opal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. The juniper holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
